title: Prometheus exporter

fields.name: add_label
fields.description: This lets you add custom labels to all metrics exposed through the Prometheus exporter.

fields.name: add_timestamp
fields.description: Add timestamp to every metric honoring collection time.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname Fluent Bit will bind to when hosting Prometheus metrics.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port Fluent Bit will bind to when hosting Prometheus metrics.

fields.name: http_server.idle_timeout
fields.description: Maximum time an idle HTTP client connection is kept open. Connections that remain idle beyond this duration are closed. Accepts time values such as 10s or 1m

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Prometheus exporter.
